column1: # POINTER-TARGET-TYPE VECTORS (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §3.1; docs/rulings.json
# pointer-target-type-checked). The root is Node in
# test/pointer-target-type/reader (value uint32; next *Node), which also
# declares Quant (q uint32). test/pointer-target-type/writer is the reader's
# successor: it declares a type the reader does not, Extra (x uint32), and its
# next points at it.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   case     what the wire's one record names
#   unit     the schema directory the root is read against, from the repo root
#   root     the table the wire is read at
#   file     the wire file, in this directory
#   verdict  `read` or `refused`
#   unknown  the report's unknown count, or `-` where the row does not pin one
# `next` naming a Node record reads; naming a Quant record (a type the reader
# DECLARES that is not the type the slot requires) refuses, and so does naming
# a *bytes blob record under a *Node slot; naming a record of the writer-only
# type reads, the pointer null and one `unknown`.
canonical
next-quant
next-bytes
next-writer-only
